rachel: quick a11y pass on the Insights > Export modal. Found 3 things: (1) radio buttons for export format are announced as \"radio\" only (no group label), (2) focus lands on the close X when modal opens instead of the first form control, and (3) the overlay spinner contrast is low in dark theme. rachel: repro (short): ``` 1) Console > Insights > Open any insight > More > Export 2) modal opens, try Tab / Shift+Tab or open with keyboard Enter 3) VoiceOver/NVDA says "radio" for each format and there's no grouping announcement; also focus starts on Close button ``` emma: saw this on macOS VoiceOver too. Users expect something like "Export options, 3 items, radios" so they know it's a group. Also focus start should be on the first selectable control (format) not the close affordance. colin: quick DOM snippet of current markup: ```html
``` colin: fix proposal: wrap radios in
+ or add role=\"radiogroup\" and aria-label on the container. Programmatically focus the first control on open (or the radiogroup container with tabindex=0 and aria-activedescendant). rachel: example patch (aria approach): ```html

JSON
``` yu: spinner contrast: overlay uses rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on dark bg; too faint. On dark themes, spinner track should be at least 30% luminance difference. propose using var(--overlay-heavy) = rgba(0,0,0,0.6) then spinner stroke white 0.95 for visibility. colin: tests: update e2e to assert that when modal opens document.activeElement is the radiogroup or first radio; add axe-core check for role=radiogroup presence; add a small VoiceOver manual QA step. emma: small SR announce polish: when user toggles a format, fire a polite aria-live message like \"Export format: JSON selected\" so assistive users get confirmation without DOM focus movement. Keep messages short. rachel: CSS patch suggestion for spinner (dark): ```css .modal--dark .overlay { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .modal--dark .spinner { stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); stroke-width: 3; } ``` a11y-bot: checklist reminder: add unit test for focus restore, e2e Tab order test, axe-core smoke test, VoiceOver and NVDA manual signoffs, and add release-notes entry under "Accessibility fixes". deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch \"fix/export-modal-a11y-1846\" to staging in 8 minutes. rachel: created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4812 with repro GIF, before/after contrast swatches, and suggested patches. Tagging 1.19 for the full fix; spinner contrast swap could land as a small patch earlier if needed. colin: happy to review the PR. I'll also add a minimal helper in our focus-manager util to prefer focusing first interactive child for dialog opens. emma: I'll QA VoiceOver + NVDA once the canary runs. Thanks folks :heart: rachel: that's it for now. will update the issue when PR is up.
